notes: Reached by direct fetch of the /in/en/ storefront, no proxy needed. This IS a genuinely separate storefront from the already-completed S.N.15 'Home Centre' (homecentre.com/ae/en/, UAE): different domain (homecentre.in vs homecentre.com), different currency (INR), a completely different SAP Hybris category-URL scheme ('decor-lighting-tablelamps' vs 'household-lighting-tableanddesklamps'), a different search backend (Unbxd here vs Algolia on the UAE site), and a non-overlapping product catalogue (different SKUs, brand tags like Homesake/Corsica/Reflection/Orion not seen on the UAE site) - confirmed not a duplicate, treated as a distinct company per the brief. Category tree discovered from the server-rendered mega-menu (241 links, 9 departments: Living Room, Bedroom, Dining Room, Decor, Kitchen, Furnishings, Tableware, Bath & Laundry, Gifting - no parallel Kids/Baby decor tree exists on this site, unlike the UAE storefront). qty is the exact 'numberOfProducts' field from the Unbxd search-index JSON embedded in each category page's __NEXT_DATA__ (the same value that drives the page's own pagination), cross-checked as an exact match on categories small enough to fit one page (e.g. Decorative Mirrors: numberOfProducts=15, unique product IDs returned=15). Also found a legacy/orphaned parallel taxonomy ('homeware-decor-...') tagged onto products but not linked from any live navigation; excluded to avoid double counting since it is unreachable via the site's own browse paths. Excluded per brief: Home Fragrances department in full (Candles, Fragrances & Potpourris, Diffusers, Aroma Oils, Room & Car Sprays - all scented), Bulbs, Artificial Plants & Flowers, Gift Accessories and the entire Gifting department, Desk Accessories (functional organisers/paper trays, not decorative), Bar Accessories, Cutlery and Table Linens (Placemats/Table Runners/Table Cloths/Trivets & Coasters/Tissue Holders - textiles/functional), all of Kitchen (Storage & Containers, Cookware, Kitchenware, Kitchen Linen, Bakeware - functional), all of Furnishings (Bedding, Cushions, Curtains & Blinds, Floor Coverings - textiles), all Living Room/Bedroom/Dining Room furniture. Salt & Pepper Shakers (dining-serving-saltandpeppershakers) is a dead nav link that 200-redirects to the homepage - excluded as retired. Two mirror-bearing categories were dropped as mixed roll-ups per the brief's 'drop, don't pad' rule after inspecting all sampled titles: 'Dresser Mirrors' (bedroom-dressermirrors, 20 items) is dominated by dresser-with-mirror furniture combos (drawers/stools), not standalone mirrors; 'Storage & Mirrors' (bathandlaundry-bathaccessories-storageandmirrors, 50 items) mixes genuine wall/vanity mirrors (~17 of 48 sampled titles) with bath storage caddies, trays and jewellery/watch boxes with no site-side filter to isolate the mirror-only subset exactly, so it was dropped rather than padded with an approximate count. The only mirrors row kept is the site's own clean 'Decorative Mirrors' category (15), all 15 sampled titles confirmed standalone wall mirrors - Rule 0 applied (mirrors in scope regardless of department) but only where the category itself is not a mixed rollup. 'Potpourri Bowls & Platters' is included as Decorative Bowls: despite the site's own page name, every sampled title is a plain empty decorative bowl (metal/glass/ceramic), not a scented potpourri-filled product. Fountains (decor-garden-indoorandoutdoorfountains) included per Rule 0: despite living under the Garden department, sampled titles are decorative resin Buddha/Ganesha/lotus water fountains, a decorative sculpture/water-feature product type, not garden tools. Pots & Kettles (8) flagged MANUAL REVIEW: mostly ceramic/porcelain teapots and sugar/creamer pots but includes one stainless-steel filter coffee maker (an appliance). Glassware/'Glasses & Jugs' (139) flagged MANUAL REVIEW: sampled titles are dominated by genuine glass drinkware (wine/whisky/highball/juice glasses, glass jugs) but also include steel and melamine travel tumblers mixed into the same listing with no way to filter them out exactly.
